title: DeepResearch Bench II: Diagnosing Deep Research Agents via Rubrics from Expert Report
authors_zh: Ruizhe Li, Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Chiwei Zhu, Xiaorui Wang, Zhendong Mao
paper_type_zh: 专家报告驱动的深度研究 Agent rubric 评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究深度研究 Agent、基于证据的 LLM Judge 与长文报告评测的读者。
one_line: DeepResearch Bench II scores deep-research reports with 9,430 expert-grounded binary rubrics across retrieval, analysis, and presentation.
DeepResearch Bench II 用源自专家报告的 9,430 条二元准则诊断深度研究 Agent 的检索、分析与呈现。
why: It grounds long-form research evaluation in verifiable expert evidence rather than ad hoc model criteria.
inclusion_reason: Expert-report-derived rubrics diagnose retrieval, analysis, and presentation in deep-research agents.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Deep-research benchmarks often let an LLM define criteria on demand, which may not match expert priorities. Even human rubrics can be too coarse and allow plausible but unsupported reports to pass. Holistic writing scores also cannot separate recall, analysis, and presentation failures.

DeepResearch Bench II extracts verifiable content from expert investigative articles and applies more than 400 hours of human review to create fine-grained hierarchical criteria anchored in expert reports rather than model preference.

深度研究基准常由 LLM 临时定义评价标准，可能与专家关注点不一致；即使采用人工 rubric，条目过粗也会让看似正确但缺乏证据的报告通过。整体写作分还难以区分信息召回、分析和呈现问题。

DeepResearch Bench II 从专家调查文章中提取可验证内容，经 400 余小时人工复核形成细粒度层级准则，用专家报告而非模型偏好作为评价锚点。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DeepResearch Bench II contains 132 grounded research tasks across 22 domains and 9,430 binary rubrics covering information recall, analysis, and presentation. Criteria are derived from expert articles through a four-stage LLM-plus-human pipeline for extraction, atomisation, verification, and hierarchy construction. The public JSONL retains tasks, sources, criteria, evidence, and per-task licences, supporting deep-research judges and report-gap diagnosis.
DeepResearch Bench II 含 132 个跨 22 领域的 grounded research task 和 9,430 条二元 rubric，覆盖信息召回、分析与呈现三维。准则来自精选专家文章，通过四阶段 LLM+human 流程提取、原子化、核验和分层；公开 JSONL 保留任务、专家来源、准则、证据和逐任务许可。数据适合深研 Agent Judge 与报告差距诊断。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select expert reports: High-quality investigative articles are selected when their questions can become open research tasks with accessible evidence.
  1. Automatic extraction: An LLM extracts candidate facts, analyses, and presentation requirements and forms an initial hierarchy.
  1. Human review: More than 400 human hours remove unverifiable items, split compound criteria, add evidence, and check atomicity.
  1. Evaluate reports: A judge evaluates all 9,430 criteria and aggregates three dimensions; retrieval dates, evidence access, and licences must be fixed.

1. 选择专家报告： 筛选高质量调查文章，确保其问题可重构为开放研究任务且证据可访问。
  1. 自动提取： LLM 从报告中提取候选事实、论证和呈现要求，并建立初步层级。
  1. 人工复核： 400 余小时人工工作删除不可验证条目、拆分复合准则、补证据并检查原子性。
  1. 评测报告： Judge 逐条判定 9,430 条准则并按三维汇总；复现需固定检索日期、证据访问和许可。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Even the strongest evaluated deep-research systems satisfy fewer than 50% of DRB2 rubrics, revealing a large gap from expert reports. Fine-grained criteria reject fluent, apparently plausible answers lacking evidence and localise failures to recall, analysis, or presentation. This supports expert-report-derived rubrics, although source articles may represent only one narrative and evidence selection.
多个先进深研系统在 DRB2 上即使表现最好，也满足不到 50% 的 rubric，显示与专家报告存在明显差距。细则能够拒绝表面流畅、结论似乎合理但缺少报告证据的回答，并将错误定位到召回、分析或呈现。结果支持专家报告衍生准则，但源文章本身可能只代表一种叙事和证据选择。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The first DeepResearch Bench used adaptive criteria, while earlier work relied on LLM-generated rubrics. DRB2 reverse-engineers evidence-bearing hierarchical binary criteria from completed expert articles and applies extensive human verification. The novelty is anchoring evaluation in expert artefact content rather than standards invented by the judge.
第一代 DeepResearch Bench 使用自适应标准，更早工作还依赖 LLM 生成准则。DRB2 从专家完成的调查文章反向构建带证据的层级二元 rubric，并投入大规模人工核验。新意是让评价锚点来自专家产物内容，而不是 Judge 自己设定标准。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: An expert article is not the only valid report; alternative reliable evidence or structures may be undervalued.
  1. Limitation 2: Source articles and data have per-task licences, so commercial reuse cannot rely only on the repository licence.
  1. Limitation 3: Expert facts on dynamic topics become stale and require periodic updates.

1. 局限1： 专家文章不是唯一正确报告，其他可靠证据或结构可能被漏评。
  1. 局限2： 源文章和数据具有逐任务许可，商业复用不能只看仓库许可证。
  1. 局限3： 动态主题的专家事实会过期，需要定期更新证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Report recall, analysis, and presentation separately and locate gaps from expert artefacts.
  1. Use case 2: Use hierarchical criteria to train a deep-research judge while allowing alternative evidence and equivalent reasoning.
  1. Use case 3: Before commercial or continuous evaluation, check per-task licences and factual update dates.

1. 使用场景1： 分别报告深研 Agent 的召回、分析和呈现，定位与专家产物的差距。
  1. 使用场景2： 用层级准则训练深研 Judge，同时允许替代证据和等价推导。
  1. 使用场景3： 商业或持续评测前逐题检查许可和事实更新时间。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Reverse-engineer verifiable research rubrics from expert investigative reports.
  2. Method: 132 tasks, LLM extraction, 400+ review hours, and three-dimensional hierarchy.
  3. Data: Twenty-two domains, 9,430 binary criteria, evidence, and per-task licences.
  4. Evidence: Strongest systems satisfy under 50%; criteria reject unsupported reports.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for deep-research judges; allow alternative evidence and inspect licences.

1. 一句话定位： 从专家调查报告反向构建可验证深研 rubric。
  2. 方法抓手： 132 任务、LLM 提取、400+ 小时复核和三维层级评分。
  3. 数据抓手： 22 领域、9,430 二元准则、证据和逐题许可。
  4. 证据锚点： 最强系统仍满足不足 50%，细则拒绝无证据报告。
  5. 复用决定： 适合深研 Judge；须支持替代证据并检查许可。
